There is **no officially established or clinically proven DHM (dihydromyricetin)** dosage or protocol for drinking alcohol . Optimal human dosing, absorption rates, and overall efficacy remain under active study.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlOEdcb-JRyNP4SEogI5FIG3qW3bcZKDLBMnFES-UlGRdiu30rnADOSy31ONlXIjDibCxg5WLEyEbqTuuGZvdgN1OukbUbbe00tzOXUE3aYE0wS-_kKG51ICxzF3Sw7admLFoaQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHtNbouSHnFiZrz1WhzuN4sbHKnM462GqBv_mDakz_WjyR7P9TubVHKxlAaYsx9BvuaAErLyFjWVSb33m1O0_6P_6rpNpXpGsGyeE0Ex1MozogNM0uUwIrrrrWVgwzgrd_gyVBgzy4GwH74GnsPzlOSn2RBBaDNtT8g)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX4zpgKyUekjGUBoV8-cmlt9WAaW59ddT3DlLTFRQ3GYpbI_y0K7OnfGlKkaSzyNrSB_Whzo89cf2297yHC2IInhyU2vA0RWR3oej7UrKKww5eYdXuDbXmTYG35QLtUB4k9GcH6_pL)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfwHEIkXXR0wsYDGuAYGnsFLzZhq-Fd8Uh2YcMTCVxdn4z4aFheossGa1uvuM9S5cUsEH0aw-0v-aK2tihBoqzXGTyorb5IsrGjkQMTcexQUciHqEHFrUwpmmvq2oJA_KQCfuzPzT5MCmrw8_1EM6BPrxzxdkAVlq1l8Ju4xCEZo)

#### Supplement Characteristics and Timing

- **Timing:** When dietary supplements containing DHM are used, they are generally taken prior to or during alcohol consumption rather than the following morning.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHtNbouSHnFiZrz1WhzuN4sbHKnM462GqBv_mDakz_WjyR7P9TubVHKxlAaYsx9BvuaAErLyFjWVSb33m1O0_6P_6rpNpXpGsGyeE0Ex1MozogNM0uUwIrrrrWVgwzgrd_gyVBgzy4GwH74GnsPzlOSn2RBBaDNtT8g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX4zpgKyUekjGUBoV8-cmlt9WAaW59ddT3DlLTFRQ3GYpbI_y0K7OnfGlKkaSzyNrSB_Whzo89cf2297yHC2IInhyU2vA0RWR3oej7UrKKww5eYdXuDbXmTYG35QLtUB4k9GcH6_pL)
- **Product differences:** Because DHM is marketed as a dietary supplement rather than an FDA-approved drug for this purpose, formulations and label instructions vary widely across brands.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX1mjdrRWWNupflIf9-DTi3Pu-N_BEy477q34IIaXXh-2k4JZawHlZxey7esCqdTkHyv3INSgxskkEAcQ07Xkivf1PfQlafo47h8niCO3z3m41yk0eM3ukkpKZn87bQ8weGvdseCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlOEdcb-JRyNP4SEogI5FIG3qW3bcZKDLBMnFES-UlGRdiu30rnADOSy31ONlXIjDibCxg5WLEyEbqTuuGZvdgN1OukbUbbe00tzOXUE3aYE0wS-_kKG51ICxzF3Sw7admLFoaQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHtNbouSHnFiZrz1WhzuN4sbHKnM462GqBv_mDakz_WjyR7P9TubVHKxlAaYsx9BvuaAErLyFjWVSb33m1O0_6P_6rpNpXpGsGyeE0Ex1MozogNM0uUwIrrrrWVgwzgrd_gyVBgzy4GwH74GnsPzlOSn2RBBaDNtT8g)

#### What the Evidence Shows

- **Limited human clinical data:** Much of the mechanistic research on DHM, alcohol metabolism, and GABA receptors comes from animal studies and early clinical trials. As summarized by the NIH's [LiverTox](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX1mjdrRWWNupflIf9-DTi3Pu-N_BEy477q34IIaXXh-2k4JZawHlZxey7esCqdTkHyv3INSgxskkEAcQ07Xkivf1PfQlafo47h8niCO3z3m41yk0eM3ukkpKZn87bQ8weGvdseCk) resource, DHM is not approved for human medical use in the United States, and short-term human studies have reported no clear toxicity so far. Ongoing research, including a [ClinicalTrials.gov Phase I dose-escalation study](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlOEdcb-JRyNP4SEogI5FIG3qW3bcZKDLBMnFES-UlGRdiu30rnADOSy31ONlXIjDibCxg5WLEyEbqTuuGZvdgN1OukbUbbe00tzOXUE3aYE0wS-_kKG51ICxzF3Sw7admLFoaQ) , is examining human safety and pharmacokinetics.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXvpDfEvA8iK8Nqc1m5LQBKwrKeb7lda44vJCYQ3CaIPc4cooqMjWvg9ydqpjL0P6XfIKDoy0ALkj7_d24NXk11ORTnY7nEX0LAfnX3DVTc6YTG08njmXdWr5MxL-mtntD1US6-7cFugA-)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXXlOEdcb-JRyNP4SEogI5FIG3qW3bcZKDLBMnFES-UlGRdiu30rnADOSy31ONlXIjDibCxg5WLEyEbqTuuGZvdgN1OukbUbbe00tzOXUE3aYE0wS-_kKG51ICxzF3Sw7admLFoaQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESagHEIkXX1mjdrRWWNupflIf9-DTi3Pu-N_BEy477q34IIaXXh-2k4JZawHlZxey7esCqdTkHyv3INSgxskkEAcQ07Xkivf1PfQlafo47h8niCO3z3m41yk0eM3ukkpKZn87bQ8weGvdseCk)
- **Realistic expectations:** DHM is not a cure for hangovers, does not prevent dehydration, and should not be relied on to prevent intoxication or allow heavier drinking. Eating beforehand and pacing alcohol intake remain foundational.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHtNbouSHnFiZrz1WhzuN4sbHKnM462GqBv_mDakz_WjyR7P9TubVHKxlAaYsx9BvuaAErLyFjWVSb33m1O0_6P_6rpNpXpGsGyeE0Ex1MozogNM0uUwIrrrrWVgwzgrd_gyVBgzy4GwH74GnsPzlOSn2RBBaDNtT8g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX4zpgKyUekjGUBoV8-cmlt9WAaW59ddT3DlLTFRQ3GYpbI_y0K7OnfGlKkaSzyNrSB_Whzo89cf2297yHC2IInhyU2vA0RWR3oej7UrKKww5eYdXuDbXmTYG35QLtUB4k9GcH6_pL)

#### Safety Precautions

- Talk with a healthcare professional before using DHM if you have **liver concerns** , take **prescription medications** (especially sedatives or drugs affecting liver enzymes), or are **pregnant or breastfeeding**.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXHtNbouSHnFiZrz1WhzuN4sbHKnM462GqBv_mDakz_WjyR7P9TubVHKxlAaYsx9BvuaAErLyFjWVSb33m1O0_6P_6rpNpXpGsGyeE0Ex1MozogNM0uUwIrrrrWVgwzgrd_gyVBgzy4GwH74GnsPzlOSn2RBBaDNtT8g)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXX4zpgKyUekjGUBoV8-cmlt9WAaW59ddT3DlLTFRQ3GYpbI_y0K7OnfGlKkaSzyNrSB_Whzo89cf2297yHC2IInhyU2vA0RWR3oej7UrKKww5eYdXuDbXmTYG35QLtUB4k9GcH6_pL)
